about: Sol City trailer: what was generated (trailer/gen.mjs). The narrator's lines (ElevenLabs v3, voice Brian; the [tags] set the delivery and are not spoken) and the score's sections, 90 BPM. The final timing of every line is in src/hype3.js (NARRATION), and trailer/mix.mjs cuts the score down to the 88-second picture.

sections.name: intro
sections.music: slow atmospheric intro: warm analog synth pad, vinyl crackle, a lone talkbox-style G-funk lead phrase, soft finger snaps, no drums yet, sunrise mood, building anticipation

lines.text: [deep, slow, almost a whisper] Sol City.
[deep, unhurried] Sun. [pause] Sea. [pause] [knowing, a hint of a smile] And a whole lot of money.
[low, dramatic] Everybody here wants a piece.

sections.name: story
sections.music: the beat drops: hard-hitting 90s west coast hip hop drums, deep rolling G-funk bassline, high whiny portamento synth lead, laid-back but menacing groove

sections.name: action
sections.music: full energy G-funk: punchy drums with extra percussion and claps, funky bass, synth lead and brass stabs, driving and triumphant

lines.text: [cool, smirking] Take any ride you want.
[punchy, rhythmic, energetic] Race it. [short pause] Jump it. [short pause] Wreck it.

sections.name: heat
sections.music: tension: drums drop to a tense half-time pattern, ominous low bass drone, police-siren-like synth stabs, dark and suspenseful

lines.text: [ominous, slow, low] But this city... [pause] fights back.

sections.name: hustle
sections.music: the groove returns: bouncy feel-good G-funk, funky guitar licks, warm bass, synth lead melody, sunny and playful

lines.text: [upbeat, wry] Drive a cab. [short pause] Save a life. [short pause] Put out a fire.
[smooth, satisfied] Then spend it... [pause] like you mean it.

sections.name: life
sections.music: sunset cruising groove: smooth laid-back G-funk, mellow synth lead, crisp drums, golden hour vibe

sections.name: crew
sections.music: breakdown: drums cut out, bass and pad only, then a big riser and snare roll building to the final drop

lines.text: [deep, building intensity] And this time... [pause] you bring your crew.
[confident, clear] Hold Sol City. [pause] Earn DaCity.

sections.name: finale
sections.music: final drop: the biggest, loudest version of the G-funk groove, all instruments, then a hard stop on a final impact hit and a short ringing tail

lines.text: [deep, slow, final] Sol City. [pause] Now playing.
